in_hebrew.name: יורק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יורק מקורו כנראה מהמילה 'ירק' שפירושה הוא 'להוריד' או 'לזרום', ויכול להתקשר לנושא השפע והברכה האלוהית. בהקשר נוצרי, השם עשוי לסמל את יורד הברכה והחסד האלוהי.

in_greek.name: Γιουρέκ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Υψιλον, φέρων τον άγιο φως
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γιουρέκ πιθανόν να συνδέεται με την ελληνική παράδοση και να συμβολίζει τον φέροντα του αγίου φωτός ή τον κομιστή της θείας χάριτος. Στην παράδοση της Ανατολικής Ορθοδοξίας, τέτοια ονόματα συχνά αντανακλούν πνευματικές αρετές και χάρη.

in_latin.name: Jurek
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jurek, origine Slavica, in traditione Christiana, potest significare 'descendit' vel 'benedictus a Deo'. Hoc nomen saepe fertur ad notionem gratiae et benedictionis divine, quae in doctrina Christiana fundamentum habet.

in_english.name: Jurek
in_english.meaning: Blessed, descended from God, or God will judge
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jurek, with possible roots in Hebrew or Slavic languages, signifies 'blessed,' 'descended from God,' or 'God will judge.' While not directly mentioned in the Bible, it relates to themes of divine blessing and judgment. Historically, the name has been used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing faith and spiritual heritage. It may also reflect qualities of righteousness and divine favor.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jurek, once prevalent in Slavic countries like Poland, Czech Republic, and Slovakia, is associated with strength, independence, and leadership. The name carries a proud and noble heritage, reflecting the spirit of the robust and free-willed Slavic people.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Jurek signifies God's bestowal of wealth or blessings. It represents the concept of stewardship, as one is called to be a responsible manager of the abundant resources, material and spiritual, that God grants.
